content.title: Helping clients thrive and communities prosper
content.text: Skip to main content Our Company What We Value We’re on a purpose-driven journey to build the RBC of the future and reimagine the role we play in the lives of our customers. Our purpose inspires us every day to bring our best and use our imagination and insights to build a better future for our clients and communities. Our Businesses For more than 150 years, we’ve gone where our clients have gone – expanding across Canada, the United States, and to select global markets. Today, we hold strong market positions in five business segments, with 17 million clients who continue to put their trust in RBC. Our Leadership Get to know the senior leaders who guide RBC’s strategic direction and culture. Corporate Governance The strengths of our corporate governance start at the top and are fostered throughout the organization by a proactive governance culture that has consistently adopted industry-leading standards. Quick Facts Royal Bank of Canada (RY on TSX and NYSE) and its subsidiaries operate under the master brand name RBC. We are one of Canada's biggest banks, and among the largest in the world based on market capitalization. We have 97,000+ full- and part-time employees who serve 17 million clients in Canada, the U.S. and 27 other countries. We are one of North America's leading diversified financial services companies, and provide personal and commercial banking, wealth management, insurance, investor services and capital markets products and services on a global basis. Awards and Recognition RBC named ‘North American Retail Bank of the Year’ for third consecutive year RBC has been recognized with multiple awards by Retail Banker International (RBI) (opens to external site). The accolades include North American Retail Bank of the Year, Best Loyalty/Rewards Strategy, and Best Latin/Caribbean Bank of the Year. Latest News
